# CodeExplorer (ce)

> Architecture intelligence for AI coding agents and engineering teams. CodeExplorer indexes a repository (C#/.NET via Roslyn plus 12 Tree-sitter languages) into a unified OpenCypher knowledge graph stored in local SQLite, and exposes it through a fast CLI, a local MCP server, Semantic Invariant Gates (SIG) for CI, and a VS Code extension.

## Get started

- Install (NuGet global tool): `dotnet tool install -g codeexplorer.cli`
- Install (Homebrew): `brew install vmikhailov/tap/ce`
- Index a repository: `ce scan --init`
- Query the graph: `ce query "MATCH (p:Project) RETURN p.name"`
- Run as an MCP server (stdio): `ce mcp` — see the [MCP server card](https://code-explorer.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
